source_system: Training completion report (94%); course outline; phishing simulation results; 15 staff interviews
what_it_shows: Annual course and quarterly phishing simulations delivered; content was not updated after the 2025-26 refund fraud, and lessons from refund diversion and help-desk impersonation are not in the training

title: Control assessment: event logging
source_system: SIEM log source list; SIS, FAMS and LMS audit settings; STD-02 draft; MSSP interview
what_it_shows: SIS, FAMS and LMS event types (record views, exports, grade changes, refund bank changes) are not identified or specified for logging and are not sent to the SIEM; no rationale is documented for the event types selected; event types have not been reviewed since the SIEM was deployed in 2023; logging is coordinated with the MSSP

title: Control assessment: audit record review
source_system: MSSP monthly reports; SIS and FAMS audit logs; refund fraud tickets
what_it_shows: SIS and FAMS user activity is not reviewed; all 23 portal takeovers in 2025-26 were reported by students; the MSSP reports SIEM findings monthly and by phone for high severity; review was not increased after the refund fraud

title: Control assessment: penetration testing
source_system: Penetration test report November 2025; statement of work; risk register
what_it_shows: An annual external test was performed; its scope (internet-facing hosts only) was not set from the risk assessment, and the student portal workflows, the partner portal and internal networks were not tested

title: Control assessment: configuration change control
source_system: Change tickets; integration platform job history; sample of 20 of 112 SIS configuration and integration job changes (2026-01 to 2026-06); CIO interview
what_it_shows: 9 of 20 sampled changes had no review, approval or security impact consideration; SIS configuration and integration job changes are not defined as configuration-controlled, their decisions are not documented and job changes are not reviewed after implementation; cloud infrastructure changes follow tickets with approval

title: Control assessment: system component inventory
source_system: Device management, cloud and SaaS register exports; card spend for fiscal 2026; Campus 3 walkthrough
what_it_shows: 14 department-bought SaaS tools holding student data were missing from the inventory; campus safety devices and Campus 3 network equipment are not in the inventory; the SaaS register has not been reconciled since 2024

title: Control assessment: contingency plan
source_system: BIA (P05) draft; 2023 incident response plan; CIO and Campus Director interviews
what_it_shows: No IT disaster recovery plan exists; the draft BIA identifies essential functions, recovery objectives and restoration priorities and is stored in the restricted GRC repository

title: Control assessment: contingency plan testing
source_system: Backup and restore records; attempted restore of one integration platform server image into an isolated network (2026-08-13)
what_it_shows: No contingency plan test has been performed; the attempted integration platform restore on 2026-08-13 failed because the image needed a license server that was not backed up

title: Control assessment: system backup
source_system: Backup job reports for July 2026; vault retention and role policies; test restore of a file-service folder
what_it_shows: 30 of 30 July 2026 backup jobs succeeded; backups are daily, write-once for 30 days, encrypted and in a separate account and region; a file-service folder was restored from the backup account

title: Control assessment: identification and authentication
source_system: IdP export; SIS and lab account lists; Campus 3 walkthrough
what_it_shows: 2 shared accounts in use: the Campus 3 cybersecurity lab administrator account used by instructors, and a shared admissions kiosk SIS account at Campus 3; process identities map to named users

title: Control assessment: MFA for non-privileged accounts
source_system: Conditional access policy; MFA enrollment report (students 54%); FAMS servicer accounts; partner portal settings; sign-in test with a test student account
what_it_shows: MFA is optional for students, and the test student account signed in with a password only; the servicer's 8 FAMS accounts and partner portal users have no MFA; no written Qualified Individual approval of alternatives

title: Control assessment: authenticator management
source_system: IdP password policy; lab local administrator audit; service account inventory; sample of 10 service desk password resets
what_it_shows: 4 of 10 sampled student resets verified the caller only by date of birth; 6 integration service account passwords not changed since 2023; the shared lab local administrator password was written in a lab binder at Campus 2 and was not changed when 3 lab instructors left in 2025-26

title: Control assessment: re-authentication
source_system: SIS portal settings; test change of refund bank details on a test student account (2026-08-11)
what_it_shows: No re-authentication is required to change refund bank details, recovery contacts or MFA methods; the test change completed in a password-only session

title: Control assessment: identity proofing
source_system: Admissions identity check procedure; sample of 30 of about 2,900 online applicant files (fall 2025); fraud log
what_it_shows: 9 of 30 sampled applicant files had no documented identity check before aid packaging; ID documents are viewed but not validated, and identity evidence is not verified against the person presenting it

title: Control assessment: incident handling
source_system: Incident queue; sample of 10 of 44 incidents (including 4 refund fraud cases); MSSP escalation records; Bursar and Information Security Manager interviews
what_it_shows: Malware incidents handled with the MSSP show preparation, detection, containment, eradication and recovery; refund fraud cases were handled by the Bursar outside the incident response process, with no root-cause analysis or check for broader compromise; lessons learned from the refund fraud were not incorporated; no common closure criteria

title: Control assessment: incident reporting
source_system: POL-03 draft; reporting interviews with 15 staff; incident queue; FSA reporting records (none)
what_it_shows: 14 of 15 interviewed staff described the reporting line correctly; incident information was not reported to FSA, the FTC or the OIG, and no external reporting procedure existed

title: Control assessment: incident response plan
source_system: 2023 incident response plan; P08 runbook drafts; distribution records
what_it_shows: The 2023 plan sets structure, approach, resources and responsibilities and is access-controlled; it does not define reportable incidents (FTC, FSA or state criteria), metrics or external information sharing; it was not reviewed or re-approved in 2024 or 2025, was not distributed beyond IT, and was not updated for the online division, Campus 3 or fraud incidents; the P08 runbook drafts add the notification criteria

title: Control assessment: media sanitization
source_system: Disposal certificates; copier lease return records (4 returns in 2025-26)
what_it_shows: Retired staff drives are wiped with a certificate from the disposal vendor; 4 of 4 leased copiers were returned to the lessor without sanitization or a certificate

title: Control assessment: physical access control
source_system: Badge system reports; walkthroughs at Campus 1 and Campus 3 (2026-08-12)
what_it_shows: Badge access, visitor escort and access logs at Campus 1 and Campus 2; no access log for the 3 Campus 3 network closets, which use keys; Campus 3 closet keys hang in the facilities office without a key log and have not been changed since the building opened, despite 2 facilities staff departures

title: Control assessment: personnel termination
source_system: Sample of 25 of 142 terminations; ERP termination records; IdP and LMS logs
what_it_shows: 5 of 25 sampled departures (adjunct faculty) kept access for more than 30 days; local LMS credentials of departed preceptors and guest instructors were not revoked; exit steps recorded for staff and full-time faculty

title: Control assessment: PII processing purposes
source_system: Data warehouse schema; AI-002 feature list; marketing analytics queries; FERPA and aid privacy notices; Director of Financial Aid interview
what_it_shows: Purposes for processing aid data are described in the aid office procedures and the privacy notice; ISIR-derived fields are processed for analytics, the AI-002 model and enrollment marketing; new uses of aid data in the warehouse were not monitored or reviewed

title: Control assessment: risk assessment
source_system: P01 risk register and report; 2025 risk assessment; vCISO interview
what_it_shows: Written risk assessments dated July 2025 and 2026-07-31 follow SP 800-30; the assessment was not updated when Campus 3 opened (2024) or when the AI tools were adopted (2025-26)

title: Control assessment: vulnerability monitoring and scanning
source_system: Scan reports Q1-Q2 2026; all 40 critical findings; scan scope configuration
what_it_shows: Scans run and are analyzed; 12 of 40 critical findings were remediated after the 30-day target; the lab and campus safety VLANs are not scanned

title: Control assessment: external system services
source_system: Contract register; sample of 20 of about 90 vendor contracts; servicer contract; SOC 2 review records
what_it_shows: The servicer does not use MFA; 5 of 20 sampled contracts lacked security terms; 22 vendors, 2 of them AI vendors, lack FERPA school-official terms; provider compliance is checked only at onboarding; oversight roles are defined

title: Control assessment: boundary protection
source_system: Firewall rule exports; Campus 3 network scan from a lab computer (2026-08-12); hub flow logs
what_it_shows: External interfaces at the cloud hub and Campuses 1 and 2 are monitored and controlled; from a Campus 3 lab computer the assessors reached staff workstations, 22 door controllers and 4 video recorders; internal interfaces at Campus 3 are not monitored

title: Control assessment: transmission confidentiality
source_system: TLS scan of portals and interfaces; sample of 20 of 312 June 2026 emails from financial aid to the servicer
what_it_shows: Portals and interfaces use TLS; 7 of 20 sampled emails with ISIR or award data were sent without encryption

title: Control assessment: flaw remediation
source_system: Patch compliance reports; campus safety device firmware list; Campus 3 lab sample
what_it_shows: Flaws on staff endpoints and servers are identified, tested and patched; Campus 3 lab computers were 3 months behind on security updates; door controller and video recorder firmware is unsupported and not updated

title: Control assessment: system monitoring
source_system: SIEM use-case list; MSSP reports; simulated credential stuffing against a test student account (2026-08-11); refund bank-change report
what_it_shows: The simulated credential stuffing and refund bank change produced no alert; there are no detections or monitoring for the SIS, FAMS or LMS; network connections are monitored and alerts analyzed by the MSSP; monitoring was not adjusted after the refund fraud

title: Control assessment: supplier assessments and reviews
source_system: Vendor files; SOC 2 review records
what_it_shows: Supplier risks were assessed only at onboarding before 2026; 6 of 14 Tier 1 vendors have not been reviewed
